# Cause IQ

> Cause IQ is a web-based platform providing nonprofit data, research tools, and CRM integrations for prospect identification, financial benchmarking, and organizational enrichment.

Cause IQ serves multiple user types including fundraising firms, nonprofit organizations, accounting firms, consultants, and financial advisors by aggregating Form 990 data, personnel information, and grant details. The platform enables users to search, filter, and enrich nonprofit prospect lists using comprehensive financial metrics and NTEE classifications.

## Key Topics

- Form 990
- NTEE codes
- Nonprofit prospecting
- Benchmarking
- CRM integration
- Salesforce
- Data enrichment
- 501(c)(3)
- Foundation grants
- Nonprofit database
- Prospect research
- CSV upload
- Schedule J
- NAICS codes
- A-133 Single Audits

## Core Platform & Features

- [Cause IQ Homepage](https://www.causeiq.com): Cause IQ homepage: nonprofit prospecting, benchmarking, enrichment tools
- [Prospect for nonprofits](https://www.causeiq.com/prospecting): Find nonprofit prospects using Cause IQ search and financial filtering
- [Research opportunities](https://www.causeiq.com/researching): Evaluate organizations using KPIs and financial metrics
- [Benchmark clients](https://www.causeiq.com/benchmarking): Compare organizations' financials and compensation using Form 990 data
- [Enrich information](https://www.causeiq.com/enriching): Augment CRM records and lists via CSV upload and Salesforce sync

## Data & Integrations

- [Better data](https://www.causeiq.com/better_data): Cause IQ data sources: personnel, grants, contacts, Form 990
- [Purpose-built tools](https://www.causeiq.com/better_tools): Cause IQ tools for prospecting, enrichment, and CRM integration
- [Integrations](https://www.causeiq.com/better_integrations): Cause IQ integrations with Salesforce, NetSuite, Zoho, Dynamics
